primaryChecks.text: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to King Solomon.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文に地名が明記される。用例の地理的意味はprofile本文で限定した。

primaryChecks.text: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.
primaryChecks.previousContext: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The king made of the almug trees pillars for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文に地名が明記される。用例の地理的意味はprofile本文で限定した。

primaryChecks.text: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.
primaryChecks.previousContext: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.
